title: A coherent module on a Noetherian scheme is filtered with quotients pushforwards of ideal sheaves of integral closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], i.e. locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then there are an integer $m\ge0$ and a chain $0=\mathcal F_0\subseteq\mathcal F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq\mathcal F_m=\mathcal F$ of coherent sub-$\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that for every $j=1,\dots,m$ there are a closed immersion $i_j:Z_j\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z_j$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and a nonzero coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal I_j\subseteq\mathcal O_{Z_j}$ with an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F_j/\mathcal F_{j-1}\cong(i_j)_*\mathcal I_j$, where $\mathcal F_j/\mathcal F_{j-1}$ is the cokernel of the inclusion $\mathcal F_{j-1}\to\mathcal F_j$ and $(i_j)_*$ is the pushforward of modules [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Define goodness by HasCoherentIntegralFiltration. An IsZero module has the length-zero bottom-subobject chain; its endpoints coincide because its subobject type is subsingleton. Transport coherence to the bottom subobject using the isomorphism clause of coherent_kernel_cokernel_sum. Empty support implies IsZero by Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero and the faithful forgetful functor from module sheaves.

proof.text: For nonempty irreducible support T, Mathlib QuasiSober.sober supplies a generic point ξ. Apply coherentIntegralFiltration_of_generic_annihilated. For each generically annihilated module H supported in T, if its support equals T, apply coherentIntegralFiltration_generic_step using the induction hypothesis; otherwise its support is strictly smaller than T, so apply the induction hypothesis directly.

proof.text: For reducible support T, Mathlib isPreirreducible_iff_isClosed_union_isClosed supplies two closed sets covering T neither of which contains T. Intersect each with T to get proper closed subsets T₁ and T₂ whose union is T. Apply exists_coherent_submodule_of_support_union to obtain a coherent submodule H and coherent cokernel supported in the respective proper subsets. Both have filtrations by the induction hypothesis. Apply coherentIntegralFiltration_of_shortExact to their canonical short exact sequence.

lean.statement: theorem exists_coherent_filtration_integral_subschemes (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) : ∃ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → Subobject F) (hc : Monotone c), c 0 = ⊥ ∧ c (Fin.last m) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ k : Fin (m + 1), RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (c k : X.Modules)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin m, ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X), IsClosedImmersion i ∧ IsIntegral Z ∧ ∃ I : Z.IdealSheafData, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules ∧ Nonempty (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (c j.castSucc) (c j.succ) (hc j.castSucc_le_succ)) ≅ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules)
